fusions.name: Itching Bristles
fusions.desc: Sheds a cone of stinging hairs that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped and Pricked
fusions.desc: Wraps the target in strands and stings it; the strike deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Screen
fusions.desc: Weaves a wall of strands 5 tiles long that nothing crosses for 8 seconds. Enemies that touch it are slowed 20% for 2 seconds and left [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lashing Strand
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles; it deals 5 damage and slows it 15% for 2 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
